title: Assignation
subtitle: Choose who answers which questionnaire, then how they sign in.

type.label: Type
type.defaultBody: The members you pick answer, each with their own session
type.followUpBody: The members you pick share one session and receive a daily reminder until it is completed

dueDate.label: Due date
dueDate.hint: The day this follow-up should be completed. Reminders keep arriving until it is.

audience.label: Who responds?
audience.areaBody: Everybody in the areas you check
audience.roleBody: Everybody with the roles you check
audience.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, area or role

questionnaire.label: Questionnaire
questionnaire.conflict: This questionnaire is already assigned to "{{organization}}". A copy of the questionnaire will be created and the copy will be assigned instead.

description.label: Description
description.hint: An internal note about this assignation. Respondents never see it.

registration.title: Registration
registration.intro: This is the sign-in slide respondents see before the questionnaire.

done.body: Share this link with the people who answer "{{name}}".

errors.audienceRequired: Check at least one person, area or role, or choose Everybody
errors.registrationContact: At least one of email or phone must be required
errors.fix: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.
errors.race: This questionnaire was just assigned to another organization. Please review and try again.
